description.html: This shallow dish has a grey, flat bottom and an outer rim shaped like stacked layers of stone, similar to slate. The basin is wide and low, and the layered outside gives the impression of a natural rock where rainwater has collected.

Shallow water is especially suitable for tortoises. They usually drink by walking into the water and also like to soak, so they need a dish they can step into and climb out of easily, with water no higher than the lower part of the shell. The same dish also suits low, short-legged lizards. Before buying, check that the dish is large enough for your tortoise to fit in.
The layers on the outside work as steps: your animal can grip them with its claws while climbing in.

Set the dish directly on the floor or press it into the substrate so it does not move when a tortoise steps on the rim. Tortoises often defecate in water, so change the water every day, or more often if needed. The grey color is easy to match with rocks and soil or hay substrates.
